name: The Mirror Room
body:
Floor-to-ceiling mirrors. Dimmable lighting. A bench that exists for aesthetic reasons and functional ones nobody pretends are not obvious.

BODY AFFIRMATION MADE ARCHITECTURAL. In a house dedicated to catharsis this room exists to force girls to LOOK. At their bodies. Their cocks. Their breasts. Their scars. The parts they were taught to hide or hate. The mirrors reflect everything AND THE LIGHTING IS KIND — warm, adjustable, designed to show skin the way a lover sees it rather than the way shame remembers it.

SIN BOLDLY is etched into the frame of the full-length mirror, because Bell believes the bravest thing a girl can do is stand naked in front of glass and say THIS IS MINE.

Elspeth's bending-over rights take priority in this room. Nobody was asked to vote on that. It simply is.
